newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise August rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise August rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it would raise the margin requirements on its August rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Tuesday.
The hike will bring the total margin fees for August to 87,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The move was intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin requirements on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
